summary: FormationEval is now a split benchmark suite with a frozen evaluated MCQ track and an imported DISKOS-QA track.
pending_note: Added March 2026. FormationEval now also includes DISKOS-QA. The public leaderboard and quiz still reflect the 505-question MCQ v0.1 track. That benchmark already answered the original model-comparison goal of the project. A full rerun on the expanded suite is pending because this is a self funded one person project and QA evaluation requires materially more token spend.

contact.note: Collaboration, compute support, and professional opportunities are welcome.
